A0.rule: All strictly positive current-cone direct opportunities, plus protected-critical relaxed opportunities with positive owner slack. No manually selected path or historical best circuit configuration.

R1.rule: All strictly positive current-cone direct opportunities, plus protected-critical relaxed opportunities with positive owner slack. No manually selected path or historical best circuit configuration.

question: Does the same automatically selected slack-owner release and joint repair advance strong A0/R1, and is any gain explained by native scheduling/extra opportunity rather than physical-plus-hard-capacity search?
accepted_state_policy: Four independent policy pointers per arm. Fixed original budgets; full candidate legality/FULLSTA before commit. New targets computed in each accepted state. No intermediate state accepted.
controls: Identical requests/objectives paired within each scope. All native paths free. Whole transaction updates occupancy after each route; if any failed, full rollback. Scope ablations start from each pristine strong baseline. A0 and R1 both receive the complete direct, relaxed, protected-owner selection stages already given to Tf. No per-circuit hand-picked target.
qualification: Development batch, not confirmation or research stop matrix. Pin slack screens releases but never substitutes for final STA. Soft native search can retry congestion pressure; attempts and failures remain counted.
